title: Detecting and Classifying Malevolent Dialogue Responses: Taxonomy, Data and Methodology
reasoning: The paper develops and benchmarks a taxonomy and dataset (HMDT/MDRDC) specifically designed to detect unethical dialogue responses. The taxonomy includes an 'unethical issues' dimension with subcategories like 'deceit' and 'immoral or illegal' behavior. It also explicitly includes the detection of negative attitudes towards religion within its 'NIA' (Negative Intergroup Attitude) category.
